name: Down And Back
summary: A 7-card draw-and-discard pot game where each hand is split into a 4-card 'down' and 3-card 'back' hand to win both halves.
rules_text: Ante to pot. Deal 7 cards each from 52-card deck. Turn up one card to start discard pile, remainder is stock. Player left of dealer starts. On a turn draw the top card of either stock or discard pile into hand, then discard one card face up. Taken card may be immediately discarded. Play 6 rounds clockwise, dealer takes last turn, reshuffling discard into new stock if stock empties. At showdown each player splits 7 cards into a 4-card going-down hand and 3-card coming-back hand. Show down hands in order and compare by rank. If same player has best down and best back hand, they win pot. Otherwise pot carries over and next hand is dealt with new antes. Ace is always low K high.
